title: Programming Contract Review
summary: Practice selected JavaScript ownership, bounded demand, ASCII matching and tree/cost review with original finite references. This is not a complete language or algorithms syllabus.
audience: Developers who want to verify concise programming summaries through explicit contracts and independent counterexamples.

units.title: Value Ownership
units.summary: Predict binding, nested sharing, own membership, conversion and call receivers under an explicit JavaScript context.

units.title: Bounded Demand
units.summary: Trace qualifying consumption, cleanup ownership, pressure signals and accepted offsets without inferring remote effects.

units.title: Text Domains
units.summary: Preserve fixed ASCII positions and separate pattern syntax, whole-input acceptance and visualization evidence.

units.title: Shape And Cost
units.summary: Separate tree shape from global ordering and compare exact operation counts under explicit representation assumptions.
